I set up the weekday 17:30 "Pod end of day" job for #strategic-pod, but it isn't active yet and won't post today.

- **Not running:** the Hermes gateway isn't running, so the job is saved but won't fire until someone starts it (`hermes gateway start`).
- **Wrong first date:** the job's first run is set to Oct 26, 17:30 UTC, not today. Today's post (Oct 14) won't happen.
- **Correction:** my first reply in the thread said I'd flag the gateway issue to whoever runs it. I can't do that from here. My second reply corrects this and asks you to flag it.

Someone with access to the Hermes host needs to start the gateway and confirm the job's next run date. Once it's running, the job will read #strategic-pod and post the digest there.
